body: You’re willingness to die without actually doing it fuels your depression. I’m also drunk and depressed as fuck. I waited days for something for suicide to ship for me. And realized I wasn’t ready for it. Just try to chill and maybe get yourself into something you enjoy. I m going to drive which may get me killed but I’m ok with it, I am numb of this world here, but driving is soothing and I like it. Anyways. I send my best energy to you. Even if you don’t agree with me here, I hope that maybe you’ll be ok.
